lines.beaver: 와, 바람이 갑자기 차가워졌네. 너 괜찮아?
lines.beaver_en: Wow, the wind suddenly got cold. Are you okay?
lines.beaver_roman: wa, barami gapjagi chagawojyeonne. neo gwaenchana?
lines.learner: 아니, 너무 추워. 재킷을 입었어야 했는데.
lines.en: No, I'm freezing. I should have worn a jacket.
lines.roman: ani, neomu chuwo. jaekiseul ibeosseoya haenneunde.

lines.beaver: 신발도 얇아 보여. 샌들 신고 왔어?
lines.beaver_en: Your shoes look thin too. Did you wear sandals?
lines.beaver_roman: sinbaldo yalba boyeo. saendeul singo wasseo?
lines.learner: 응, 발이 차가워. 운동화를 신었어야 했는데.
lines.en: Yeah, my feet are cold. I should have worn sneakers.
lines.roman: eung, bari chagawo. undonghwareul sineosseoya haenneunde.

lines.beaver_en: Your skirt is short too. No stockings?
lines.learner: 응, 안 신었어. 스타킹이라도 신었어야 했는데.
lines.en: No, I didn't. I should have at least worn stockings.
lines.roman: eung, an sineosseo. seutakingirado sineosseoya haenneunde.

lines.beaver_en: Is that skirt a thick one?
lines.learner: 아니, 체크무늬 면 스커트라 얇아. 통도 넓고.
lines.en: No, it's a thin checkered cotton skirt. It's wide, too.
lines.roman: ani, chekeumunui myeon seukeoteura yalba. tongdo neolkko.

lines.beaver: 가방은 괜찮아? 비가 올 것 같은데.
lines.beaver_en: Is your bag okay? Looks like it might rain.
lines.beaver_roman: gabangeun gwaenchana? biga ol geot gateunde.
lines.learner: 작은 손가방이라 걱정이야. 우산도 안 가져왔어.
lines.en: It's a small handbag, so I'm worried. I didn't bring an umbrella either.
lines.roman: jageun songabangira geokjeongiya. usando an gajyeowasseo.

lines.beaver_en: I even wore a vest under my windbreaker.
lines.learner: 역시 너는 똑똑해. 나도 조끼를 입었어야 했는데.
lines.en: You're so smart. I should have worn a vest too.
lines.roman: yeoksi neoneun ttokttokae. nado jokkireul ibeosseoya haenneunde.

lines.beaver_en: Someone stepped on your foot on the subway earlier, right?
lines.learner: 응, 사람들한테 밀려서 샌들 신은 발을 밟혔어.
lines.en: Yeah, I got pushed by the crowd and my sandaled foot got stepped on.
lines.roman: eung, saramdeulhante millyeoseo saendeul sineun bareul balpyeosseo.

lines.beaver_en: That must have hurt. But why is your belt undone?
lines.en: My belt broke. I'll try tying it with a string.

lines.beaver: 지금 몇 시야? 시계 좀 봐 줘.
lines.beaver_en: What time is it? Check your watch.
lines.beaver_roman: jigeum myeot siya? sigye jom bwa jwo.
lines.learner: 손목시계도 집에 두고 왔어. 오늘 실수투성이야.
lines.en: I left my wristwatch at home too. Today is full of mistakes.
lines.roman: sonmoksigyedo jibe dugo wasseo. oneul silsutuseongiya.

lines.beaver: 내 점퍼 빌려줄게. 이제 카페로 가자.
lines.beaver_en: I'll lend you my windbreaker. Let's go to the café now.
lines.beaver_roman: nae jeompeo billyeojulge. ije kapero gaja.
lines.learner: 고마워! 날씨를 먼저 봤어야 했는데. 가자!
lines.en: Thanks! I should have checked the weather first. Let's go!
lines.roman: gomawo! nalssireul meonjeo bwasseoya haenneunde. gaja!
